goal: Implement and review an exact candidate-input primality function with a native Graphics illustration
invariants: Primality is evaluated exactly on nonnegative integers; 0 and 1 are neither prime nor composite.
No prior-prime list is an input to either candidate function; independent oracles are validation only.
Rendering illustrates exact arithmetic and does not decide primality by floating phase.
Preserve previous accepted media and evidence; credit established Wilson and trial-division methods; no RH or speed breakthrough claim.
